hero.title: Democracy, human rights and the rule of law must continue to be protected
hero.lead: I am a Peruvian lawyer and public policy specialist in Berlin. For more than ten years I have worked on democratic governance, human rights and civil society, implementing projects in Latin America, Europe, Africa, the Middle East and Asia. This page is my expression of interest for Head of Democracy at ECNL.

bio.title: Short biography
paragraphs: I am a Peruvian lawyer and public policy specialist based in Berlin, with more than ten years of experience in democratic governance, human rights and civil society.

Until August 2026 I  was Executive Director of the International Federation of Liberal Youth (IFLRY), a global federation of more than 100 member organisations in over 60 countries, where, together with the board, I led strategy, fundraising and donor relations.

Before that, I drafted legislation as an advisor in the Peruvian Congress and worked on transparency and accountability at Peru's Office of the Comptroller General. My human rights work began at the Inter-American Commission on Human Rights. I later trained Cuban activists to use the Inter-American system and helped draft reports that Cuban civil society organisations submitted to the Commission.
I co-founded Somos Ciudadanía, a Peruvian civic education NGO, and hold a law degree from Universidad de San Martín de Porres and a Master of Public Policy from the Hertie School.

ai.title: The use of AI in our daily life
ai.text: AI now decides who is seen at a protest (through camera tracking), which posts stay online (through filtering) and who gets a public service (through automated eligibility checks). Governments and technology companies are shaping these rules every day, and civil society needs a voice in how they are made.

points.title: Assembly
points.text: Facial recognition and surveillance can make people afraid to gather in public.

points.title: Expression
points.text: Automated moderation shapes what can be said, often with no way to appeal.

points.title: Participation
points.text: Digital public services and consultations can leave out people who are already unheard.

ai.use: I use AI in the creative process of turning ideas into working tools. It is hard to imagine what the future will look like, but AI is shaping it. Even so, we humans are, and must remain, the main actors in that process.
